folk-horror village elder, pre-industrial, rendered as cel-shaded concept art moodboard, a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only, unglazed stoneware

You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'folk-horror village elder, pre-industrial, rendered as cel-shaded'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights. Lighting reference: hard low sun raking across the surface with long cast shadows.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
